source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.post_title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

methods.outcome: Identified the analytic source-degree pressure exactly with a binary linear-code Hamming weight enumerator for parity-conditioned gauge coordinates. Derived an exact hard-core polymer representation on the generator-intersection graph and a private-coordinate cancellation certificate yielding an interior zero-free/KP pressure bound even when boundary chi-square is exponential.

Showed overlap itself is harmless until code distance collapses; built a connected visible arity-4 gauge-Gibbs null preserving exact low-degree orthogonality and proved fixed local gauge refresh drives chi-square and TV to zero. Breaking gauge symmetry by pairwise coupling creates an exact exponentially small degree-two leakage coefficient, identifying the first missing hypothesis for a pairwise-Ising extension.

Derived an exact bounded-arity factor-table representation of the code weight enumerator and one-table softened two-replica Fourier coefficients. Isolated the all-order gluing obstruction: actual degree is symmetric-difference degree, so weighted KP needs a cancellation/no-cancellation profile rather than ordinary unweighted factor size.

key_new_claims: For linearly independent parity generators on iid gauge coordinates, 1+G_h(z)=W_C(z)=sum_{c in C} z^{|c|}, so zero source LDA through D is exactly d_min(C)>D while boundary collision is W_C(1)=2^M.

If every generator row has at least u private coordinates and the generator-intersection degree is bounded, connected polymer activities satisfy |w_z(gamma)|<=|z|^{u|gamma|}, giving a standard KP zero-free/interior-pressure certificate; u_n>=cD_n makes fixed interior pressure vanish for M_n<=n.

The connected visible Gibbs null Q(a,b) proportional exp[J sum A_iB_i + K sum (A_iB_i)(A_{i+1}B_{i+1})] factorizes into iid local gauges G_i=A_i and an interacting Y_i=A_iB_i Ising chain, so parity-code planting remains exactly orthogonal although the visible factor graph is connected and arity at most four.

Under local gauge refresh, 1+chi2(P S_t^G||Q)=W_C(e^{-2t}); hence the connected gauge-Gibbs subclass has zero source LDA through D_n and TV->0 for every fixed t even when log(1+chi2(P||Q))=M_n log 2 is much larger than D_n.
Adding pairwise gauge-breaking epsilon sum A_iA_{i+1} creates exact degree-two leakage rho^{m/2-1} sqrt(1-rho^2)/(1+rho^{m/2}), rho=tanh epsilon, for an even length-m parity condition.

A local weighted polymer upper bound must use cancellation-aware symmetric-difference degree |triangle S_a|; naive multiplication of individual z^{|S_a|} discounts can under-estimate true high-degree activity after coordinate cancellations.

prior_art_state: Binary linear-code weight enumerators and Tutte/MacWilliams/Greene theory, Kotecky-Preiss/tree-graph cluster expansions and zero-free consequences, local gauge symmetries, Walsh noise stability, Gibbs heat-bath dynamics, Kato/Toda transport, and Renyi/collision divergence are classical. The source-directed synthesis is not claimed novel.

next_methods.attack: Generalize local Z2 gauge symmetry to finite local groups; use irreducible representations and minimum nontrivial representation support as a code-distance analogue, seeking a complete weight-enumerator/character partition function.

Deform the exact connected gauge model by a small pairwise gauge-breaking coupling and bound the entire low-source-degree projection through D_n using high-temperature expansion, aiming for a genuinely connected pairwise-Ising subclass.

Optimize the interior weight enumerator at fixed row size, generator-intersection degree and cancellation/private-coordinate budget to sharpen the local cancellation profile beyond the conservative private-coordinate KP bound.
